item.title: Gender-diverse Australian sailors barred from US submarines despite Aukus deal, documents reveal
item.description: Defence briefing released under freedom of information laws shows ADF beholden to US directives when in training Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Aukus is effectively forcing the Australian navy to comply with a US ban on transgender people in the military with gender-diverse navy recruits prevented from starting a career in nuclear submarines because they would not be safe training on US boats. Internal Australian defence force documents show transgender and non-binary sailors and officers are explicitly banned from Australia’s nuclear submarine training program… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Four in a row - Australia win women's rugby league World Cup again
item.description: Jamie Chapman scores a hat-trick to help Australia comfortably beat New Zealand 34-10 in the women's rugby league World Cup final, securing a record-breaking fourth successive title. Publicado también por: Al Jazeera English. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: 'We got disrespected' - Walsh and Australia make World Cup point

item.title: The Philippines and Australia strengthen joint military deterrence at ASEAN summit
item.description: Southeast Asian leaders opened their annual summit in the Philippine capital Manila on Sunday. During three days, world leaders are expected to focus on trade, energy and conflict – including the war in Iran. Donald Trump is expected to land in Manila on Tuesday. Details by FRANCE 24 correspondent in Bangkok Tommy Walker. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Jordan sentences 3 men to death over deadly church attack
item.description: A Jordanian court on Sunday sentenced three men to death by hanging over a deadly church shooting, as the kingdom’s Christmas celebrations were cancelled in solidarity with the victims’ families. Gunmen killed nine people and wounded 25 others when they stormed a funeral at a Greek Orthodox church in southern Hammoud village, Karak governorate, on October 23. Authorities said three men, two Jordanian brothers and their relative by marriage, had fled after the attack and were arrested three days... Publicado también por: ABC News Australia, The Hindu - International. Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: Anthony Albanese welcomes Trump-Xi-Putin summit – even as European leaders express reservations
item.description: ‘We think dialogue is a good thing,’ Australian PM says after German chancellor urges the US to work with Europe for peace in Ukraine Australia has endorsed this week’s historic summit between Donald Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin in China, even as European leaders warn that the US president must not make major concessions over the war in Ukraine. The three-way summit is planned to take place in Shenzhen, where the leaders will gather for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) meeting. Likened to the 1945 summit at Yalta , the Ukrainian president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, has warned… Fuente: The Guardian - World.
